# Christopher Cant

> A comprehensive resource for digital artists covering creative fundamentals, tool reviews, and the business of freelance art creation.

Christopher Cant is a freelance fantasy and sci-fi illustrator who shares actionable advice for self-employed artists through guides, reviews, and educational content. The site also features worldbuilding and supernatural lore articles that complement the artistic practice.

## Key Topics

- Digital Painting
- Digital Art Fundamentals
- Clip Studio Paint
- Freelance Artist Journey
- Creative Tools Review
- Digital Art Styles
- Self-Employed Artist
- Fantasy & Sci-Fi Illustration
- Digital Art Tutorial
- Society6
- Procreate
- TourBox Elite Plus
- Art Techniques
- Worldbuilding
- Medieval Weapons

## Core Pages

- [Christophercant Home](https://www.christophercant.com): Homepage for Christopher Cant, freelance fantasy/sci-fi artist and creator

- [About Sheila](https://www.christophercant.com/sheila/about-sheila): About page for Sheila Ahurani, illustrator and writer collaborator

## Digital Art Guides & Fundamentals

- [Self Employed Artist | Actionable Advice for Digital Artists](https://www.christophercant.com/Blog): Self-Employed Artist blog with digital art guides and creative career advice
- [The 6 Fundamentals of Art (And a Few Extra)](https://www.christophercant.com/blog/the-fundamentals-of-art): Guide to the six fundamentals of art for beginner digital artists
- [Digital Art Styles](https://www.christophercant.com/blog/digital-art-styles): Overview of major digital art styles from realism to anime and game art
- [Sketching vs Drawing; What's The Difference?](https://www.christophercant.com/blog/sketching-vs-drawing-whats-the-difference): Educational guide comparing sketching and drawing techniques and purposes
- [Articles](https://www.christophercant.com/art): Articles on digital art tools, reviews, and freelance artist guides

## Creative Tools & Software Reviews

- [The Best Brushes for Clip Studio Paint! Free and Paid for CSP](https://www.christophercant.com/blog/the-best-brushes-for-clip-studio-paint-free-and-paid-csp): Resource guide for free and paid brush packs for Clip Studio Paint
- [Artist's Review of the TourBox Elite Plus!](https://www.christophercant.com/blog/tourbox-elite-plus-artist-review): Artist review of TourBox Elite Plus hardware for digital painting workflow
- [Society6 Artist Review; Is It Worth Using?](https://www.christophercant.com/blog/society6-artist-review-is-it-worth-using): Review of Society6 print-on-demand platform for selling artwork online

## Worldbuilding & Supernatural Lore

- [Six Unanswered Questions About Vampires](https://www.christophercant.com/post/six-unanswered-questions-about-vampires): Article exploring unanswered questions about vampire folklore and mythology
- [What Are Vrykolakas? Greek Vampires](https://www.christophercant.com/post/what-are-vrykolakas-greek-vampires): Guide to vrykolakas, Greek vampires from mythology and folklore
- [What Is a Werewolf's Lifespan? Are They Immortal?](https://www.christophercant.com/post/what-is-a-werewolfs-lifespan-are-they-immortal): Analysis of werewolf lifespan and immortality in folklore and fiction
- [Ghost vs Spirit vs Wraith vs Poltergeist vs Phantom](https://www.christophercant.com/post/ghost-vs-spirit-vs-wraith-vs-poltergeist-vs-phantom): Guide to paranormal terminology: ghosts, spirits, wraiths, and related beings

## Fantasy & Medieval References

- [Castle vs Palace; What's The Difference?](https://www.christophercant.com/post/castle-vs-palace-whats-the-difference): Illustrated guide comparing architectural differences between castles and palaces
- [Mace vs Morningstar](https://www.christophercant.com/post/mace-vs-morningstar): Historical comparison of medieval weapons: maces versus morning stars
